# Muhammad Zain Ul Abideen

> Medical Laboratory Scientist, Computational Biologist and Molecular Modeler from Lahore, Pakistan. BS Medical Laboratory Sciences, The University of Lahore (June 2026). Research: molecular docking and molecular dynamics on the gut-brain axis (NK1R receptor). First-author publication in the Pakistan Journal of Biochemistry and Biotechnology (2026). Member, Global Scholars Network (GSN) (Higher Education Commission, Pakistan). Seeking a fully funded MS by Research position and research collaborations.

## Research
- Final-year thesis (2025-2026): In silico molecular docking and dynamics simulation of gut-derived postbiotic metabolites against the human neurokinin-1 receptor (NK1R, PDB 6HLO). 52 metabolites screened with AutoDock Vina against four approved NK1R antagonists as benchmarks; lead candidates Urolithin B and a benzofuran-2-one derivative; validation with DFT, 100 ns molecular dynamics, MM-PBSA and MM-GBSA.
- Publication (first author): Gene Therapy Approaches for Treating Childhood Leukemia: Current Progress and Future Directions. Pakistan Journal of Biochemistry and Biotechnology 7(1): 65-79 (2026). https://pjbb.wum.edu.pk/index.php/ojs/article/view/314
- Peer reviewer for the Pakistan Journal of Biochemistry and Biotechnology (2026).
- Manuscripts in the journal pipeline: microscopic evaluation of urine (hematuria and pyuria vs bacterial culture); clinical assessment and early diagnostic approaches for dengue virus infection.
- Docking videos (screen recordings of the workflow): https://izainkhan.com/videos

## Skills
- Computational: molecular docking (AutoDock Vina), molecular dynamics (GROMACS), DFT, MM-PBSA/MM-GBSA, SwissADME, ProTox, pkCSM, STRING, Cytoscape, SPSS
- Laboratory: hematology, biochemistry and microbiology diagnostics, HIMS/LIMS
